sentences.text: Shubham Saini vs State Of Uttarakhand on 18 July, 2023

Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
 High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
 Second Bail Application No.138 of 2023
Shubham Saini ..Applicant
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand ...Respondent

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. Gaurav singh, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. Lalit Miglani, A.G.A. for the State.

Applicant Shubham Saini is in judicial custody in Fir No. 381 of 2022 (Sessions Trial No. 251 of
2022), under Sections 498A, 304B, 302 Ipc, Police Station Bhagwanpur, District Haridwar.

He has
sought his release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the co-accused have already been granted bail.
It is a case of dowry death.
On a small issue the deceased had committed suicide.
4. Learned State counsel would submit that during investigation, the witnesses have supported the prosecution.

5. The bail order dated 23.09.2022 recorded in First Bail Application No. 1753 of 2022, Saroj Vs.
State of Uttarakhand, is quite in detail.
It records as to what were the circumstances.
6. Having considered, this Court is of the view that the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
8. Let the applicant be released on bail, on his executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Court concerned.

(Ravindra Maithani, J.) 18.07.2023 Jitendra Shubham Saini vs State Of Uttarakhand on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148116118/
